prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Woodberg Roofing and Restoration** looks like a strong first call for Denver hail damage: its BBB profile describes storm-damage and insurance-claim work, and the search results include positive customer reviews specifically about hail repairs. [BBB profile and reviews](https://www.bbb.org/us/co/denver/profile/roofing-contractors/woodberg-roofing-and-restoration-llc-1296-90245804)

I’d get at least two more inspections before choosing. **Metro City Roofing** is another option with positive hail-damage feedback in its BBB profile; **Hilltop Contracting** advertises hail inspections and reports local licensing and insurance. [Metro City Roofing](https://www.bbb.org/us/co/denver/profile/roofing-contractors/metro-city-roofing-1296-90261616) · [Hilltop hail services](https://www.hilltopcontractinggc.com/services/hail-storm-damage)

Before signing, verify the contractor’s license for your municipality, insurance, references, written scope and warranty. Don’t feel pressured to sign immediately or let a roofer promise that your insurer will cover the work.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
